restaurantName: The Tea Room at The Midland Hotel
bio: The Tea Room at The Midland is Manchester's only setting specifically designed for, and dedicated to, Afternoon Tea. Enjoy a range of delicious treats at this Grade II listed building set in the heart of this buzzing city.  Served in opulent surroundings overlooking St Peter's Square, The Tea Room possesses its own knowledgeable team and features a Chefs Counter where guests can view a member of the hotel's expert pastry team skilfully prepare their afternoon tea before it is served fresh to their table.  Offering a fresh approach to traditional afternoon tea, The Tea Room works closely with local suppliers and takes pride in sourcing the highest quality ingredients. Guests can choose from an extensive selection of bespoke loose-leaf tea served with finely cut sandwiches, freshly baked scones with jam and clotted cream, and a range of delicate cakes and pastries.  The hotel is located just 200m from Oxford Road Station, 800m from Piccadilly Station and across the road from Manchester Central.
pageTitle: The Tea Room at The Midland Hotel
